prompt: THIS IS A SCREENSHOT OF AN ORIGINAL FIRST-PERSON SHOOTER VIDEO GAME BEING PLAYED on a modern PC, not box art and not concept art. First-person camera at eye height. In the lower right of the frame the player's hands in worn leather gloves hold a brass-framed lever-action rifle of the 1870s with a walnut stock and dark octagon barrel, pointing into the scene, no maker's marks. A small plain crosshair in the centre. A minimal HUD: a slim health bar bottom left, a small ammunition count bottom right, nothing else, no other text. The world: around the year 1880, a grand old-world stone city of arches, colonnades, domes and bell towers that is being burned on purpose. The enemies are a made-up order of arsonists: men in long dark oilcloth coats with brass buckles, leather hoods and round smoked goggles, carrying burning torches and rifles; they are clearly readable against the background. The route forward is clear: the player can see where to go. Do not copy any existing game's characters, HUD, logos or art; no real people, no real flags or symbols; no watermark, no typography. 16:9 landscape. Scene and style A, grounded and realistic at night: a wide cobbled street between tall stone arcades, buildings on both sides on fire, deep blue night sky against orange flame, thick smoke, sparks in the air, wet cobbles reflecting fire, an abandoned hand-pumped fire engine as cover, three arsonists ahead at different distances, one on a balcony. Photoreal modern lighting, strong contrast, cinematic but still a game frame.
